prior_credit: Published period key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list).
Earlier repository OCR retained the source as an unverified block; its full snapshot is preserved here.
Source restoration, conditional frame and readable edition: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.
limits: Printed page and reception date remain 15 November; Nov7-9 is the identifier of the registered key that decrypts the body, not a corrected source date.
The source explicitly says Very irregular spark. Four source slots are excluded and one unknown slot is added; this is a conditional model, not a uniquely authenticated error mechanism.
TRANSPOR is the received spelling. No T is silently added to the encoded stream.
Steamer names remain ??PASIA and IBALIA. The first-name initial domain differs among tied frames. No vessel identity is asserted.
The quantity remains literal 11??0K. Its two unresolved positions obey one global 5/6 square completion and one retained source-mask coordinate.

glyph_review.basis: Both glyphs are C-like without a clear G bar at high resolution. Preserve C as an invalid source glyph; independently retain all C/G combinations for sensitivity.
